title: export: Mermaid + DOT + SVG emitters + architecture report
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W4]
Seats: PROD-01, PROD-02, PROD-03, PROD-04
crates/gui/src/export/{mermaid,dot,svg,report}.rs: text emitters for call graph, CFG, types, modules and (where sensible) flow trace; hand-rolled SVG (no new crate) for the same; report.rs builds a Markdown 'architecture report' (overview metrics, module map, hotspots/complexity table, refs summary, diagrams as embedded Mermaid fenced blocks). Extend the Export menu with these targets writing to a chosen path. Owner: crates/gui/src/export/*. Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; unit tests assert Mermaid and DOT output for a fixed fixture graph is byte-stable and valid (balanced fences, unique node ids).
